episodes.synopsis: Ryoga challenges Ranma, but Ranma's battles with Cologne have made him far stronger. When Cologne appears before the vengeful Ryoga, what is her motive?
episodes.title: Training Meals

episodes.synopsis: Akane tags along for Ranma's training, while Ryoga works to master the deadly "The Breaking Point." How will their clash unfold when Akane gets involved?
episodes.title: The Breaking Point

episodes.synopsis: The Tendo family hits the beach. As Happosai runs wild, Ranma tries to set him up with Cologne — but it seems they share a past tied to an heirloom.
episodes.title: Happosai Days Are Here Again

episodes.synopsis: A man on a wild horse grabs Ranma. The culprit: Sentaro, heir of the Daimonji School of Martial Arts Tea Ceremony. A fierce succession battle begins!
episodes.title: The Way of Tea

episodes.synopsis: Akane and Kodachi battle over homemade cookies. As Ranma chases after Kodachi and the stolen treats, Gosunkugi secretly snaps a compromising photo.
episodes.title: The Way the Cookie Crumbles

episodes.synopsis: Ranma fights over a secretly taken photo with Kodachi, while Akane begins to suspect her scheme. Can Ranma get the photo negative and destroy the proof?
episodes.title: I Ate the Whole Thing

episodes.synopsis: Ryoga tells Ranma he will soon part with P-chan after finding a map to the Japanese Spring of the Drowned Man — but it leads to the girls' locker room?
episodes.title: Quest for the Hidden Spring
